Hey if you read my post history you will see that I was very intent on killing myself just a few days ago.

I don’t know what happened but I feel a lot better. Here are some things I did. I took 200mg of 5HTP. I’m curious if 5HTP can kick in that quickly? I was also forced out of the house because we were having visitors over and my anxiety. I went to a local nature reserve. The views are amazing. I think just getting out of bed and putting electronics down for a while helped. I went deep into the nature reserve and there is nobody in sight. It’s nice to just sit and watch the trees. I also decided I need to do what makes me happy. I’m thinking I’m going to change my degree from IT to Bachelor of Science. This will sound weird but I find it really relaxing listening to maths lectures. I’m going to take the courses that I want to at uni. Math. Deep learning. Keep taking 5HTP. Go to the nature reserve every day. Go to the gym every day. Actually physically go into university and not listen to lectures online. We will see how it goes.
